digest.component_or_area: docs/adr/ ADR numbering and indexing system
propositions: ADR numbering has 17 duplicate numbers across 91 files (5x0037, 3x0007, 3x0035, and 9 others doubled), creating collision and ambiguity
Collisions are prevented by per-number marker files docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN with ADR filename content, producing add/add git conflicts on duplicate claims
22 duplicate-numbered ADRs are renumbered to 0070-0091 in ascending landing-date order; earliest-landed ADR of each collision retains original number

Cross-references to moved ADRs across docs/ and src/ are rewritten to their new numbers; slug-bearing links are resolved by topic, ancestry, or co-landing; bare-number references remain recorded UNRESOLVED
CI checks scripts/check_adr_numbers.py and scripts/gen_adr_index.py enforce ADR-marker bijection, unique numbers, unique marker content, and referential integrity of all adr/NNNN-slug markdown links
